subject.title: fix(gateway): add per-request cancellation to prevent late node.invoke dispatch

question: Must this repair implement the canonical per-request timeout/cancel contract now, rather than landing only connection-close cancellation?
rationale: The proposed signal source leaves the primary timeout reproduction unresolved; accepting partial hardening would intentionally narrow the security contract specified by the canonical issue.

options.title: Require full request lifetime
options.body: Add request-level timeout/cancel signaling and the server-owned pending-to-effecting transition before merge.

options.title: Accept partial hardening
options.body: Land disconnect-only protection only with explicit security-owner acceptance and keep the timeout work open.

recommendation.title: Require full request lifetime
recommendation.body: Add request-level timeout/cancel signaling and the server-owned pending-to-effecting transition before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored, owns, and is assigned to the canonical issue that defines the required security boundary.
